The Soviet Komar-class (Project 183R) fast attack craft, entering service in 1958, were a revolutionary new type of coastal combat ships, thanks to their armament of SS-N-2 "Styx" anti-ship missiles, the first such practical weapon to be operationaly deployed on tactical ships (larger missiles such as the SS-N-1 "Scrubber" and SS-N-3 "Shaddock" were typically nuclear-tipped and intended for strategic strikes). The Soviet Union mass-produced and distributed these ships liberally to its allies and client states as a way of reducing their vulnerability to western "gunboat diplomacy".
